name: Camp Walt Whitman
description_short: An overnight summer camp in Piermont, New Hampshire, built mainly around a seven-week full summer, with shorter first and second sessions for some age groups. The site lists athletics, arts, adventure and water sports.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Summer Camp Sessions & Enrollments | Camp Walt Whitman

warnings: Short sessions (First or Second Session) are mainly for campers currently in 2nd–3rd grade. For campers finishing 4th–7th grade they are offered only in limited numbers, and after finishing 6th grade every camper must attend all seven weeks.
The grade range is unclear. The page says 'currently in 2nd and 3rd grades' (the school year before camp) and 'finishing 4th through 7th grades', and does not state the oldest grade served.
The activities list comes from the site's menu, not from a description of the program.
